ego_speed_definition: norm of current raw ego_dynamic_state[0:2], m/s; official EgoStatus ego_velocity channels
command_definition: current stored driving_command, exactly four finite binary channels with exactly one active channel; preserve raw indices 0/1/2/3, do not infer intent from future trajectory
command_semantics_evidence: OpenScene source72860746787a67946bef07aa1f78bbbc6b20e445, docs/dataset_stats.md:122 and DriveEngine/process_data/helpers/driving_command.py:40-100; route-derived current command, not measured future turn; local export exact provenance not independently established
recording_definition: current raw log_token identifies native recording; count missing log_token separately; log_name identifies exported segment
small_group_action: show counts and metrics but withhold interpretation; no significance or difference claims
aggregation: equal scene mean multiplied by 100; counts include original scenes; no ranking by model scores
missing_metadata_action: retain every expected scene in missing_or_invalid groups; never silently exclude
